# Phase Two — Critique and Twenty Improvements

The first map finds structure; Gevurah now tests its borders. The Awtsmoos gives no license for a pretty abstraction that leaks across Awtsmoos.com.

1. Add a selector audit that rejects unscoped universal, `html`, and `body` rules in migrated style modules.
2. Require every local style entry to be import-only so ownership is visible.
3. Introduce route-specific root attributes rather than relying on class-name uniqueness alone.
4. Define local layer tokens instead of arbitrary z-index numbers.
5. Add `isolation: isolate` to top-level visual surfaces where stacking containment is required.
6. Use `min-inline-size: 0` on grid/flex children that can otherwise overflow.
7. Use `overflow-wrap: anywhere` for user/source identifiers and API paths.
8. Protect fixed controls with `env(safe-area-inset-*)`.
9. Ensure dialogs and drawers constrain both block and inline size.
10. Make disclosure state ARIA-synchronized, not merely visually retracted.
11. Give every icon-only control a reliable accessible name and visible focus state.
12. Distinguish pointer hover effects from touch press effects with media capability queries.
13. Prevent animation from running on hidden panels.
14. Add reduced-motion alternatives for every decorative animation family.
15. Standardize loading, empty, error, offline, and success state anatomy.
16. Treat network errors as typed boundary results instead of console-only failures.
17. Separate API transport from DOM rendering and user-intent coordination.
18. Replace vague state variables with domain-specific immutable or narrowly mutable models.
19. Document public module contracts before changing imports or exports.
20. Capture browser receipts at phone, tablet, and desktop widths before declaring a page complete.
21. Audit sticky/fixed elements for containing-block surprises caused by transforms.
22. Avoid backdrop effects where they materially hurt low-end mobile performance.
23. Keep motion durations tokenized locally and short enough for rapid workflows.
24. Ensure advanced controls are discoverable through meaningful labels rather than mystery glyphs.
25. Verify keyboard escape/back behavior for every modal, rail, launcher, and menu.

## Revised principle

The shared system supplies behavior patterns and scoped primitives, never page sovereignty. Every route chooses its own composition and remains independently testable.
